dsh-multi-workspace 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。多工作区沙箱：自动赋予所有已注册工作区的文件写入权限——添加工作区后即可直接写入，无需配置或提权。

posts.en:
dsh-multi-workspace is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8ece8761d04de92554aa.html
